trigger: Required-delivery OCI run has no candidate and its current request crosses the work budget, with or without a registered verifier.
before: Local positive regression failed with WORK_TOKEN_BUDGET before planning. Two continuation regressions then reproduced loss of reserve after planning and rejection of a preplanned repair.
after: Current-request estimation enters durable closure reserve. Missing verifiers use the existing two-attempt plan/task-only path. Registering a plan and checkpoint restoration preserve reserve access; total budgets and approval requirements remain unchanged.
limits: Does not claim to resolve the independent grader failure or the total-input failure in other cases.
